position.name: Backend Engineer - JVM (all genders)
position.keywords: Java, Kotlin, Scala, Spring Boot, AWS

jobDescription.name: About the Role
jobDescription.value: Journi is a Vienna-based travel-journaling app. Our backend runs on the JVM -- mostly Kotlin and Java with Spring Boot, some Scala in the data pipeline. You'll build services that power our mobile apps.

jobDescription.name: What We Offer
jobDescription.value: 2-4 years of backend experience. We are an internationally distributed team and provide visa sponsorship and relocation support for candidates moving to Vienna.
